queries.query: Translating PFAS adsorption results from batch tests to continuous treatment. Prepare a focused review of when batch adsorption results do and do not predict column, pilot, or full-scale PFAS treatment performance.
Compare the information provided by equilibrium capacity, kinetics, fixed-bed breakthrough, bed volumes treated, and media lifetime.
Assess how flow, contact time, influent variability, competing constituents, and PFAS mixtures affect translation across scales.
Identify the minimum evidence needed to support a defensible service-life or scale-up claim.
